worldcombat.skill.needlearm.summary: Drop low and lunge a step, then sweep a thorny arm right-to-left across a wide arc: those caught take physical damage and may be left flinching (briefly unable to act), and each foe takes only one main hit for the whole swing. Broad form sweeps wider and farther; heavy form hits harder and comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.0: Sweep a wide arc in close and clear out foes crowding you
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.1: Catch a target circling to your side, where a wide arc does not miss
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.use.2: Settle each foe only once across the whole multi-beat swing
The thorny arm sweeps an arc, striking each caught enemy once for about %1$s physical damage with a %2$s-block sweep radius.
It first lunges %2$s blocks (%3$s blocks per tick), then sweeps %1$s degrees right-to-left in three beats; being blocked by terrain stops it in place to swing.
Each caught target has a %1$s chance to flinch for %2$s, unable to start new moves or make ordinary attacks; any one foe is settled with only one main hit per swing.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.growth.0: From level %1$s the swing rises to %2$s and the sweep radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.preference.b: On: a wider arc that sweeps farther, but a lighter swing, slower wind-up and longer cooldown — for clearing several foes crowding you or circling to your side. Off (heavy form, default): a heavier swing that comes out faster with a shorter cooldown, but a narrower arc.
worldcombat.skill.needlearm.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before swinging; larger values swing earlier and give the foe time to step away on approach.

On: rank the swing first when several foes are close, someone is circling to the side, or the target is grounded, and rank a running target lower. Off: treat it as a plain melee move with no arc-coverage bonus.
